scope: Read-only review of committed Source/Config changes from baseline to HEAD plus the current uncommitted GameMode development spawn-group support. Existing build evidence was compared and packaged PE files were rehashed; no build, UE run, asset audit or gameplay retest was performed.
conclusion: No additional damage, fire-rate, spread, collision or persistence-rule mutation was found in this diff. No new source-level release blocker was identified. Extraction overlap selection, development gates and role-specific build provenance are explicit below.

production_changes.area: Extraction region feedback and overlap selection
production_changes.behavior: Select the containing region before evaluating availability; publish its unavailable reason and cancel hold. In overlaps, initial selection follows map-definition order and an existing selection is retained even if unavailable instead of switching to another available exit.
production_changes.boundary: This includes an intentional selection behavior change, not only HUD text. Empty-pack item counting, hold duration, capacity consumption and durable-settlement ordering are unchanged.

production_changes.behavior: Only a valid current ExtractionPlayerController with its owning Player backlink, no pending swap, a loaded world and valid ExtractionPlayerState can start or count as ready. Retired seamless-travel controllers are excluded; missing state on a current controller remains an initialization error.
production_changes.boundary: Restart still requires Waiting phase, Alive state, no pawn and CanRestartPlayer. This does not add active-raid respawning.

production_changes.behavior: Right-top empty-pack condition moves to the point-name line. Central feedback includes the point name and server-confirmation state; progress is visible only during a positive hold. The world TextRender label is hidden in game.
production_changes.boundary: No exit volume, Contains logic, empty-pack condition, distance calculation or authoritative completion rule is changed.

production_changes.behavior: Add four narrow always-cook roots for Looting UI, medical-gun meshes, item definitions and the default key-room door mesh.
production_changes.boundary: No gameplay numeric configuration values changed from the baseline.

diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.behavior: Append sequence and server time only after a successful accepted shot; retain at most 64 records.
diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.boundary: Passive developer-build observation; no replicated or saved field and no shot acceptance/rejection rule change.

diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.gate: Explicit nonzero CVar plus HasAuthority() and !bPredicted
diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.behavior: Log initialization and first blocking impact; no new per-tick log, trace, damage calculation or projectile mutation.
diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.boundary: The CVar is default-off but is not wrapped in WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS. Do not claim it is compiled out of Shipping.

diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.gate: Entire driver is WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS; the automation test requires an allowed test role and nonempty test directory. Aim probes additionally require ExtractionFlightDiagnostics and a configured aim target; exit_config only accepts the Server role.
diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.behavior: Read-only diagnostic traces/snapshots plus explicit isolated development fixture commands.
diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.boundary: The diagnostic traces do not alter production aim, muzzle origin, projectile collision or damage. Fixture exit schedule changes are not ordinary gameplay verification.

diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.gate: WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS AND ExtractionTestRole=Server AND nonempty ExtractionTestDir before reading ExtractionTestSpawnGroup
diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.behavior: Restrict candidates to the specified authored group; unavailable group or failed ground validation returns failure rather than falling back to another group.
diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.boundary: Without those development arguments, existing random group selection and recovery remain. This is server-process command-line configuration, not a client RPC or a teleport.
diagnostic_and_fixture_gates.build_coverage: This exact working file hash occurs in Editor10, the latest HUD Client native build and the reused Server native build.

package_boundaries.server_difference: The reused Server was built before the client-only ExtractionWidget.cpp line-layout change. No other Source/Config hash differs.
package_boundaries.stage_scope: Client-only HUD text layout native rebuild. Server binary, cooked resources and runtime dependencies byte-identical to 04. No new Cook or Server rebuild claimed.
package_boundaries.release_wording: Latest Editor and Client match current Source/Config. Server reuse is intentional and differs only in the later HUD layout file. Do not claim every target has the identical latest source manifest or that this stage performed a fresh Cook.
package_boundaries.optional_completion: Rebuild Server only if an identical latest Source/Config manifest for every target is required; the review found no additional server-logic build gap.

packaged_pe_verification.method: Current packaged files inspected for MZ/PE AMD64 headers and streaming SHA-256; compared with native build, staged package and route07 recorded hashes.

route07_boundary.note: PE identity and source coverage are separate from route outcome; route07 is recorded failed and is not promoted to a complete-route pass.
